close_reason: Created tests/contactcard_query_tests.rs (2 tests: query filter, queryChanges); clippy clean
description:
**What:** Create crate-jmap-contacts-client/tests/contacts_query_tests.rs with 7 async wiremock tests. Oracle: §3.3.1 (filter field names including slash-keyed), §3.3.2 (sort property names).

**Tests:**
1. contact_card_query_no_filter_sends_no_filter_field: assert request has no filter key.
2. contact_card_query_in_address_book_filter: pass {"inAddressBook":"ab1"}; assert filter.inAddressBook in request. Oracle: §3.3.1.
3. contact_card_query_sort_by_name_surname: pass sort [{"property":"name/surname","isAscending":true}]; assert sort[0].property=="name/surname" with literal slash preserved. Oracle: §3.3.2 SHOULD support name/surname.
4. contact_card_query_position_and_limit: assert position and limit in request.
5. contact_card_query_changes_returns_correct_response: assert old/new queryState, removed, added.
6. contact_card_query_changes_with_max_changes: assert maxChanges in request.
7. contact_card_query_changes_empty_state_returns_invalid_argument: assert InvalidArgument before network.

**Acceptance criteria:** All 7 tests pass. Slash in name/surname wire value preserved (not URL-encoded).
title: Wiremock tests: ContactCard/query and /queryChanges
